{{Quote|Good heavens! Artoo reports they are directing beamed ultrasonics at each of us in turn. He suggests they are probing our internal structures in order to decide which of us might be good to eat!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Assault at Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
The '''corridor ghoul''' was a [[Mutant|mutated]], eyeless, [[Canine/Legends|dog-like]] creature in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] dangerous [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]]. They were discovered by [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] when they were scouting locations underground for possible 'safe houses'. After initial encounters, they learned to leave the corridor ghouls alone, who served as a form of natural defense system against intruders. In appearance, the ghouls were quadrupedal animals that stood about a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall with [[Color/Legends|pale]] skin, long [[Limb/Legends|legs]], large [[Ear/Legends|ears]], long muzzles and [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and no visible [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They had a strong sense of smell and navigated by echolocation, using high-pitched, [[Human/Legends|human]]-like screams in both the human auditory range and the ultrasonic range in concert with their ears to locate prey. They were clever, eager hunters with a strong constitution and minds sharp and direct enough to be resistant to [[Jedi Mind Tricks|Jedi mind tricks]] that relied on simple misdirection, and prone to attacking when cornered. They often appeared in groupings of three or more.<ref name="Assault at Selonia" />
